final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), st AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS savg, COUNT(*) AS n FROM j GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation), ph AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(savg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(n) AS telescope_count FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM ph) AS share_of_total FROM ph
